function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

That function is for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual player ranking. So we cannot use function. We can answer based on knowledge. But we need to check if we have up-to-date knowledge. As of 2026, we don't know. But we can say "I don't have real-time data." We can provide general info: For men's singles, ATP rankings; for women's singles, WTA rankings. But we can't give current ranking. So we should respond that we don't have real-time data.
